label: simulated from the paper’s equations (our simulation)
notes: RK45, rtol 1e-10, atol 1e-12, x(0) = [10, 0], v(0) = 0, as stated in §3.2
parameters as stated give undamped modes 3.26 and 9.52 Hz; the paper reports 4.1 and 9.5 Hz (see the accuracy note in projects/dynamics/AGENTS.md)
sampling at 25 Hz and the 6 s record are our assumptions; relative peak heights depend on record length (mode 2 is more damped, so a longer record shrinks its peak)

ar_x1: OUR least-squares AR(p) fits of x1 alone (unconstrained signs), the linear analogue of the delay count; x1 of a 2-DOF system is exactly AR(4), so p = 4 fits to rounding error. Not the paper’s transformer.
